title: 迪士尼季度利润增长超预期，乐园与流媒体双引擎发力
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: elsewhere in the world of earnings, Disney is gaining after the company beat estimates thanks to stronger streaming profits and sold demand to add theme parks. Let's get more with Bloomberg
segments.zh: 在其他财报消息中，迪士尼股价上涨，因公司业绩超预期，流媒体利润强劲，主题公园需求旺盛。

segments.en: intelligence media analyst Geitha Raganoff and Geitha, what were your takeaways?
segments.zh: 现在连线彭博智库媒体分析师Geitha Raganoff，Geitha，你怎么看？

segments.en: Yeah, as you pointed out, Danny, the two parts that matter most for Disney, which are, you know, the parks and streaming and both those delivered really strong results. I think coming into this quarter
segments.zh: 正如你所说，Danny，对迪士尼最重要的两块业务——主题公园和流媒体，都交出了强劲的成绩单。

segments.en: investors were definitely very, very concerned about the health of the parks, just kind of given the general consumer softness that we've seen. And also some commentary from Universal Parks, from
segments.zh: 本季度前，市场参与者对公园业务健康状况非常担忧，因为整体消费疲软，加上环球影城等竞争对手的评论。

segments.en: Comcast, suggesting that there was a slowdown in their domestic parks. But, you know, what we saw from Disney was exactly the opposite. Their parks profit rose by 20% versus consensus expectations
segments.zh: 康卡斯特也暗示其国内公园业务放缓，但迪士尼却恰恰相反，其公园利润增长20%，远超市场预期的10.5%。

segments.en: of 10 and a half percent. And really what they pointed to was very, very strong attendance trends both of the domestic parks and very strong per capita spending. And so I think that really
segments.zh: 他们指出，国内公园的入园人数和人均消费都非常强劲，这大大缓解了市场的担忧。

segments.en: allays a lot of fears. And then on streaming, we saw them kind of more than, you know, outperform expectations, again, getting to a 13% operating margin. Now, remember, operating margin is really
segments.zh: 在流媒体方面，他们也超出预期，运营利润率达到13%。记住，运营利润率才是这个行业的关键。

segments.en: what matters in this business. And everybody is trying to get to that not start of about 20, 25, 30% where Netflix is, but looks like Disney is making really, really good progress on that front.
segments.zh: 大家都在努力达到Netflix那样的20%到30%的利润率，但迪士尼似乎已经取得了很好的进展。

segments.en: Now, they announced that tie up with TikTok and I'm wondering if that's offence or defense for them.
segments.zh: 现在他们宣布与TikTok合作，我想知道这是进攻还是防守？
